entities.name: Levelers
entities.description: Giant, merciless Juggernauts created by Memnarch that ripped through Mirrodin once each century.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Creator of the Levelers, later deposed.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Plane ravaged by the Levelers each century.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Character whose family the Levelers killed.

entities.name: Leveler War
entities.description: War that began after Levelers killed Glissa's family.

entities.name: Fifth Dawn
entities.description: Conflict the Leveler War later became.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Mirrodin after its compleation; absorbed many captured Levelers.

events.summary: Levelers killed Glissa's family in an attack, causing the Leveler War and later the Fifth Dawn.
events.quote: They killed Glissa 's family in one such attack, causing what became known as the Leveler War and later the Fifth Dawn .

events.summary: When Memnarch was deposed, the Levelers were left leaderless; many were captured and absorbed into New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Many were captured and absorbed into New Phyrexia .

relations.quote: giant, merciless Juggernauts created by Memnarch
